[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope and application] (4) Any appropriate court fee shall be allowed in addition to the costs set out in this Section. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope and application] (5) The claim form may include a claim for fixed commencement costs. ## Amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim for the recovery of money or goods

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim for the recovery of money or goods] 45.17. —(1) In a claim to which rule 45.16(2)(a) or (b) applies, where the claim form includes a claim for fixed commencement costs—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim for the recovery of money or goods] (a)the amount of fixed commencement costs is set out in Table 2; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim for the recovery of money or goods] (b)the amount claimed, or the value of the goods claimed if specified, in the claim form is to be used in determining the band in Table 2 that applies to the claim. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim for the recovery of money or goods] (2) The amounts shown in Table 6 are to be allowed in addition, if applicable. ## When defendant only liable for fixed commencement costs

## 45.18. Where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.18. Where—] (a)the only claim is for a specified sum of money; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.18. Where—] (b)the defendant pays the money claimed within 14 days after being served with the particulars of claim, together with the fixed commencement costs stated in the claim form,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.18. Where—] the defendant is not liable for any further costs unless the court orders otherwise. ## Fixed costs on entry of judgment in a claim for the recovery of money or goods

## 45.19. Where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] (a)the claimant has claimed fixed commencement costs under rule 45.17; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] (b)judgment is entered in a claim to which rule 45.16(2)(a) or (b) applies in the circumstances specified in Table 3,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] the amount to be included in the judgment for the claimant’s legal representative’s charges is the total of—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] (i)the fixed commencement costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] (ii)the relevant amount shown in Table 3. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] 45.20.—(1) The amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim to which rule 45.16(2)(c), (d) or (f) applies is set out in Table 4. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] (2) The amounts shown in Table 6 are to be allowed in addition, if applicable. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.19. Where—] 45.21. Table 5 sets out the amounts to be allowed in respect of a legal representative’s charges in the circumstances mentioned. ## Miscellaneous fixed costs

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Miscellaneous fixed costs] 45.22. Table 6 shows the amount to be allowed in respect of legal representative’s charges in the circumstances mentioned. ## Fixed costs of enforcement

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Fixed costs of enforcement] 45.23 . Table 7 shows the amount to be allowed in respect of legal representatives’ costs in the circumstances mentioned. The amounts shown in Table 6 are to be allowed in addition, if applicable. ## SECTION III HM Revenue and Customs

## Scope, application and interpretation

## 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (a)the only claim is a claim conducted by an HMRC Officer in the County Court for the recovery of a debt; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (b)the Commissioners obtain judgment on the claim. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (2) Where this Section applies, unless the court orders otherwise, the only costs allowed in respect of HMRC charges are those specified in this Section. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (3) For the purpose of this Section—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (a)‘His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs charges’ means the fixed costs set out in Table 8 and Table 9;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (b)‘HMRC Officer’ means a person appointed by the Commissioners under section 2 of the Commissioners for Revenue and Customs Act 2005(1) and authorised to conduct County Court proceedings for recovery of debt under section 25(1A) of that Act;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (c)‘debt’ means any sum payable to the Commissioners under or by virtue of an enactment or under a contract settlement; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (d)‘Commissioners’ means commissioners for HMRC appointed under section 1 of the Commissioners for Revenue and Customs Act 2005. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (4) HMRC charges must, for the purpose of this Section, be claimed as ‘legal representative’s costs’ on relevant court forms. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (5) Any appropriate court fee shall be allowed in addition to the costs set out in this Section. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.24 .—(1) This Section applies where—] (6) The claim form may include a claim for fixed commencement costs. ## 45.25. The amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim to which rule 45.24 applies—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.25. The amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim to which rule 45.24 applies—] (a)is set out in Table 8; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.25. The amount of fixed commencement costs in a claim to which rule 45.24 applies—] (b)the amount claimed in the claim form is to be used for determining which claim band in Table 8 applies. ## 45.26. Where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.26. Where—] (a)an HMRC Officer has claimed fixed commencement costs under Rule 45.25; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.26. Where—] (b)judgment is entered in a claim to which rule 45.24 applies,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.26. Where—] the amount to be included in the judgment for HMRC charges is the total of—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.26. Where—] (i)the fixed commencement costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.26. Where—] (ii)the amount in Table 9 relevant to the value of the claim. ## Scope and interpretation

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope and interpretation] 45.27. —(1) This Section applies to claims that have been or should have been started under Part 8 in accordance with Practice Direction 49F (‘the Stage 3 Procedure’). [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope and interpretation] (2) A reference to Claim Notification Form or Court Proceedings Pack is a reference to the form used in the relevant Protocol. ## Application of fixed costs and disbursements

## 45.28. The only costs allowed are—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.28. The only costs allowed are—] (a)the fixed costs in accordance with Table 10 and Table 11; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.28. The only costs allowed are—] (b)the disbursements in accordance with Section IX of this Part. ## Amount of fixed costs

## 45.29 .—(1) In Table 10 and Table 11—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.29 .—(1) In Table 10 and Table 11—] ‘Type A fixed costs’ means the legal representative’s costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.29 .—(1) In Table 10 and Table 11—] ‘Type B fixed costs’ means the advocate’s costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.29 .—(1) In Table 10 and Table 11—] ‘Type C fixed costs’ means the costs for the advice on the amount of damages where the claimant is a child. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.29 .—(1) In Table 10 and Table 11—] (2) ‘Advocate’ means a person exercising a right of audience as a representative of, or on behalf of, a party. ## Where the claimant obtains judgment for an amount more than the defendant’s relevant Protocol offer

## 45.30. Where rule 36.30(1)(b) or (c) applies, the court shall order the defendant to pay

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.30. Where rule 36.30(1)(b) or (c) applies, the court shall order the defendant to pay] (a)where not already paid by the defendant, the Stage 1 and 2 fixed costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.30. Where rule 36.30(1)(b) or (c) applies, the court shall order the defendant to pay] (b)where the claim is determined—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.30. Where rule 36.30(1)(b) or (c) applies, the court shall order the defendant to pay] (i)on the papers, Stage 3 Type A fixed costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.30. Where rule 36.30(1)(b) or (c) applies, the court shall order the defendant to pay] (ii)at a Stage 3 hearing, Stage 3 Type A and B fixed costs; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.30. Where rule 36.30(1)(b) or (c) applies, the court shall order the defendant to pay] (iii)at a Stage 3 hearing and the claimant is a child, Type A, B and C fixed costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.30. Where rule 36.30(1)(b) or (c) applies, the court shall order the defendant to pay] (c)disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part. ## Settlement at Stage 2 or Stage 3 where the claimant is a child

## 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)the claimant is a child;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)there is a settlement—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (i)at Stage 2 of the relevant Protocol; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (ii)after proceedings are started under the Stage 3 Procedure and the settlement is more than the defendant’s relevant Protocol offer; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (c)an application is made to the court to approve the settlement. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (2) Where the court approves the settlement—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)where paragraph (1)(b)(i) applies, at a settlement hearing at Stage 2 of the relevant Protocol; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)where paragraph (1)(b)(ii) applies, at the settlement hearing under the Stage 3 procedure,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] it shall order the defendant to pay—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (i)the Stage 1 and 2 fixed costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (ii)the Stage 3 Type A, B and C fixed costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (iii)disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (3) Where the court does not approve the settlement—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)at a settlement hearing at Stage 2 of the relevant Protocol; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)at the settlement hearing under the Stage 3 procedure,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] it shall order the defendant to pay the Stage 1 and 2 fixed costs. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (4) Paragraphs (5) and (6) apply where the court does not approve the settlement at the first settlement hearing but does approve the settlement at—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)where paragraph (1)(b)(i) applies, a second settlement hearing; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)where paragraph (1)(b)(ii) applies, the Stage 3 hearing. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (5) At the second settlement hearing or Stage 3 hearing, as appropriate, the court shall order the defendant to pay—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)the Stage 3 Type A and C fixed costs for the first settlement hearing;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (c)the Stage 3 Type B fixed costs for one of the hearings. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (6) The court in its discretion may also order—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)the defendant to pay an additional amount of either or both the Stage 3—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (i)Type A fixed costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (ii)Type B fixed costs; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)the claimant to pay an amount equivalent to either or both of the Stage 3—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (i)Type A fixed costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (ii)Type B fixed costs. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.31. —(1) This rule applies where—] (7) Where paragraph (1)(b)(ii) applies and the settlement is not approved at the Stage 3 hearing the court shall order the defendant to pay the Stage 3 Type A fixed costs. ## 45.32. Where

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.32. Where] (a)the claimant is a child; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.32. Where] (b)at a settlement hearing or the Stage 3 hearing the court orders that the claim is not suitable to be determined under the Stage 3 Procedure,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.32. Where] the court shall order the defendant to pay—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.32. Where] (i)the Stage 1 and 2 fixed costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.32. Where] (ii)the Stage 3 Type A, B and C fixed costs. ## Settlement before proceedings are issued under Stage 3

## 45.33. Where

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.33. Where] (a)there is a settlement after the Court Proceedings Pack has been sent to the defendant but before proceedings are issued under Stage 3; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.33. Where] (b)the settlement is more than the defendant’s relevant Protocol offer,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.33. Where] the fixed costs shall include an additional amount equivalent to the Stage 3 Type A fixed costs. ## Additional advice on the value of the claim

## 45.34. —(1) Where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] (a)the value of the claim for damages is more than £10,000;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] (b)an additional advice has been obtained from a specialist legal representative, and that advice—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] (i)is within the legal representative’s specialist expertise; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] (ii)is reasonably required to value the claim,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] the fixed costs may include an additional amount equivalent to the Stage 3 Type C fixed costs. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] (2) In a claim to which the RTA Protocol applies—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] (a)vehicle related damages are excluded for the purpose of valuing a claim under paragraph (1)(a); and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.34. —(1) Where—] (b)‘vehicle related damages’ has the meaning ascribed to it by paragraph 1.1(18) of the RTA Protocol. ## Failure to comply or electing not to continue with the relevant Protocol – costs consequences

## 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (a)does not comply with the process set out in the relevant Protocol; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (b)elects not to continue with that process,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] and starts proceedings under Part 7. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (2) Subject to paragraph (3), where a judgment is given in favour of the claimant but—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (a)the court determines that the defendant did not proceed with the process set out in the relevant Protocol because the claimant provided insufficient information on the Claim Notification Form;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (b)the court considers that the claimant acted unreasonably—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (i)by discontinuing the process set out in the relevant Protocol and starting proceedings under Part 7;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (ii)by valuing the claim at more than £25,000, so that the claimant did not need to comply with the relevant Protocol; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (iii)except for paragraph (2)(a), in any other way that caused the process in the relevant Protocol to be discontinued; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (c)the claimant did not comply with the relevant Protocol at all despite the claim falling within the scope of the relevant Protocol,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] the court may order the defendant to pay no more than the fixed costs in rule 45.28 together with the disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (3) Where a judgment is given in favour of the claimant but the claimant did not comply with the process in paragraph 6.3A(2) of the RTA Protocol, the court may not order the defendant to pay the claimant’s costs and disbursements save in exceptional circumstances. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (4) Where the claimant starts proceedings under paragraph 7.29 of the RTA Protocol or paragraph 7.27 of the EL/PL Protocol and the court orders the defendant to make an interim payment of no more than the interim payment made under paragraph 7.19(2) or (3) of the RTA Protocol or paragraph 7.18(2) or (3) of the EL/PL Protocol the court shall, on the final determination of the proceedings, order the defendant to pay no more than—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (a)the Stage 1 and 2 fixed costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (b)the disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.35. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (5) Nothing in Section VI or Section VII of this Part shall prevent the court making an order under this rule where appropriate. ## Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] 45.36. —(1) This rule applies where an application is made under rule 45.40 (costs-only application after a claim is started under Part 8 in accordance with Practice Direction 49F). [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (2) Where the settlement is more than the defendant’s relevant Protocol offer the court shall order the defendant to pay—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (a)the Stage 1 and 2 fixed costs where not already paid by the defendant;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (b)the Stage 3 Type A fixed costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (c)disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (3) Where the settlement is less than or equal to the defendant’s relevant Protocol offer the court shall order the defendant to pay—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (a)the Stage 1 and 2 fixed costs where not already paid by the defendant; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (b)disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Where the parties have settled after proceedings have started] (4) The court may, in its discretion, order either party to pay the costs of the application. ## 45.37. Where rule 36.30(1)(a) applies, the court shall order the claimant to pay

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.37. Where rule 36.30(1)(a) applies, the court shall order the claimant to pay] (a)where the claim is determined—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.37. Where rule 36.30(1)(a) applies, the court shall order the claimant to pay] (i)on the papers, Stage 3 Type A fixed costs; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.37. Where rule 36.30(1)(a) applies, the court shall order the claimant to pay] (i)at a hearing, Stage 3 Type A and B fixed costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.37. Where rule 36.30(1)(a) applies, the court shall order the claimant to pay] (b)any Stage 3 disbursements allowed in accordance with Section IX of this Part. ## Adjournment

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Adjournment] 45.38. Where the court adjourns a settlement hearing or a Stage 3 hearing it may, in its discretion, order a party to pay

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Adjournment] (a)an additional amount of the Stage 3 Type B fixed costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Adjournment] (b)any court fee for that adjournment. ## Account of payment of Stage 1 and Stage 2 fixed costs

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Account of payment of Stage 1 and Stage 2 fixed costs] 45.39. Where a claim no longer continues under the relevant Protocol the court shall, when making any order as to costs including an order for fixed recoverable costs under Section VI or Section VII of this Part, take into account the Stage 1 and Stage 2 fixed costs that have been paid by the defendant. ## 45.40. —(1) This rule sets out the procedure where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.40. —(1) This rule sets out the procedure where—] (a)the parties to a dispute have reached an agreement on all issues (including which party is to pay the costs) which is made or confirmed in writing; but

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.40. —(1) This rule sets out the procedure where—] (b)they have failed to agree the amount of those costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.40. —(1) This rule sets out the procedure where—] (c)proceedings have been started under Part 8 in accordance with Practice Direction 49F. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.40. —(1) This rule sets out the procedure where—] (2) Either party may make an application for the court to determine the costs. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.40. —(1) This rule sets out the procedure where—] (3) Where an application is made under this rule the court shall determine the costs in accordance with the relevant provisions in rule 45.31 in so far as that rule applies to proceedings started under the Stage 3 Procedure and the settlement is more than the defendant’s relevant Protocol offer or rule 45.36. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.40. —(1) This rule sets out the procedure where—] (4) Rule 44.5 (amount of costs where costs are payable pursuant to a contract) does not apply to an application under this rule. ## Failure to comply with, or continue under, the RTA Small Claims Protocol

## 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (a)does not comply with the process set out in the Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims Below the Small Claims Limit in Road Traffic Accidents (‘the RTA Small Claims Protocol’); or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (b)either—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (i)elects not to continue with that process; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (ii)elects not to proceed with that process having been notified by the defendant pursuant to paragraph 6.15(4)(b) of the RTA Protocol that if proceedings were issued, the small claims track would be the normal track for that claim,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] and starts proceedings under Part 7 which are not allocated to the small claims track. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (2) Where a judgment is given in favour of the claimant, but—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (a)the court considers that the claimant acted unreasonably—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (i)by valuing the overall claim at more than £10,000 or the claim for damages for injury at more than £5,000, so that the claimant did not need to comply with the RTA Small Claims Protocol;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (ii)by electing not to proceed under the RTA Small Claims Protocol, following notification pursuant to paragraph 6.15(4)(b) of the RTA Protocol; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (iii)in any other way that caused the process in the RTA Small Claims Protocol to be discontinued; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] (b)the claimant did not comply with the RTA Small Claims Protocol at all despite the claim falling within the scope of the Protocol,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.41. —(1) This rule applies where the claimant—] the court may order the defendant to pay no more than the fixed costs together with disbursements allowed in accordance with paragraphs 1.13 and 1.14 of Practice Direction 27B. ## Claims which do not continue under the RTA Small Claims Protocol

## 45.42. —(1) This rule applies where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.42. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)a claim has been started under the RTA Small Claims Protocol, but no longer continues under that Protocol; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.42. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)the claim has not subsequently proceeded under the RTA Protocol. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.42. —(1) This rule applies where—] (2) Where this rule applies, Section VI of this Part applies as though the claim had started under the RTA Protocol, except where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.42. —(1) This rule applies where—] (a)the court makes an order under rule 45.41; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.42. —(1) This rule applies where—] (b)the claim no longer continues under the RTA Small Claims Protocol because either the claimant or defendant becomes a protected party as defined in rule 21.1(2). ## SECTION VI Fixed Costs in the Fast Track

## Scope

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope] 45.43 .—(1) This Section applies to any claim which would normally be or is allocated to the fast track. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope] (2) This Section does not apply where Section IV, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part applies. ## Amount of fixed costs

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Amount of fixed costs] 45.44. For so long as the claim is allocated neither to the small claims track, the intermediate track or the multi-track, the only costs allowed in any claim which would normally be or is allocated to the fast track are

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Amount of fixed costs] (a)the fixed costs in Table 12; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Amount of fixed costs] (b)the disbursements as set out in Section IX of this Part.
